I'll give this a shot for you. Keep in mind that there is a decently broad range of opinions within the altright, so many people would probably disagree with me on some of my responses. I consider myself a white nationalist, for the record.

What constitutes "white"? Is it skin color + physical features or is it ancestry or what?

"Whiteness" is a somewhat fluid concept, but most of us generally agree that whites are descendants of Nordic and Germanic ethnic groups. The most famous umbrella term for these groups is "Aryan."

Are jews counted as white?

Ashkenazi Jews and Sephardic Jews are both considered their own ethnic groups. So to answer your question, an Ashkenazi Jew that displays the typical Jewish physical characteristics (think Sarah Silverman, Jerry Seinfeld, etc) would not be considered white. There are, on the other hand, some ethnically white individuals who have converted to the religion of Judaism. It gets confusing because Judaism is a religion while Ashkenazi Jews are an ethnic group. These two concepts mostly overlap, but not always.

Do different looking groups of white people, who both are considered white yet look distinct (Swedes vs Spaniards, for instance) both count as white?

Swedes, Danes, Nords, etc (the Nordic ethnic groups) are inarguably white. So are Anglo-Saxons and Germans.

Spaniards are more difficult because of the huge amount of Moorish admixture their population experienced when they were invaded by North African Muslims. You'd have to see a Spaniard's 23andme results to find out which region their ancestors come from. Some Spaniards with mostly Castillian roots are mostly white, while some Spaniards will be almost indistinguishable from North Africans, genetically speaking.

Do you think different races exhibit different behaviors based on nature(something inherent or genetic), or is more due to nurture (culture, environment, etc) ?

Are your views on race in any way dependent on the biological evidence, or do your views on race not at all hinge on genetic arguments?
